decisions.reason: The submarine lighting line is distant from the core offer and only mentioned on the website, but the firm invested in several models for a long-cycle naval niche where early slow results can still be blamed on temporary procurement timing, so it persists for now.
The medical examination light builds on established competence and is presented on its own page, so its visible commitment and modest ongoing cost favour keeping it.
The explosion-proof industrial line carries heavy certification and multi-model investment, sits in the firm's core industrial customer base and is publicly showcased, making a drop very unlikely.
The relaunched designer task light was publicly announced as a revival of a popular product, so dropping it would expose the relaunch decision, and it fits the core offer.
